dental.why.coverage: The plan is only for people with no access to private dental insurance, even coverage you don’t use.
dental.why.taxes: You (and your partner) need to file your tax returns in Canada, so your family income can be assessed.
dental.why.income: Your adjusted family net income needs to be under $90,000.
dental.why.resident: You (and your partner) need to be Canadian residents for tax purposes.
dental.cover.title: What the plan pays
dental.cover.plan: of the plan’s set fees for covered care
dental.cover.ifNote: Based on your income only. You don’t meet requirement {n} below.
dental.cover.overSub: Adjusted family net income must be under {limit}.
dental.cover.unsetSub: Move the slider or type your income to see how much the plan would pay.
dental.income.label: Adjusted family net income
dental.income.hint: Line 23600 (net income) on your tax return and your spouse’s or partner’s, minus any UCCB and RDSP income (lines 11700 and 12500), plus any amounts repaid (lines 21300 and 23200). Your co⁠-⁠payment is set by this number.
dental.tier.sr: Income from {from} to {to}: you pay {pct}% of the plan’s fees.
dental.tier.srOver: Income of {limit} or more: not eligible.
dental.reqs.title: The 4 requirements
dental.req.coverage.q: Can you or your family get private dental insurance?
dental.req.coverage.hint: Count it even if you don’t use it: through a job, a pension, a family member’s plan or a health spending account. Government programs don’t count.
dental.req.taxes.q: Did you file last year’s tax return in Canada?
dental.req.taxes.hint: Your spouse or common-law partner must have filed too, so your family income can be assessed.
dental.req.income.q: Is your adjusted family net income under $90,000?
dental.req.income.hint: Set it with the slider above, or type the exact amount.
dental.req.resident.q: Are you a Canadian resident for tax purposes?
dental.req.resident.hint: Your spouse or common-law partner must be too.
dental.know.title: Good to know
dental.know.partner: Your dependants go on your application. Your spouse or common-law partner must submit their own.
dental.know.renew: Applications for {period} are open. Coverage ends each June 30, and you renew every year.
dental.know.extra: Your dentist may charge more than the plan’s fees. Ask what you’ll pay before treatment. Orthodontics aren’t covered right now.
dental.know.provider: Dentists and other oral health providers take part voluntarily. Before you book, ask if they accept Canadian Dental Care Plan clients.
dental.know.nihb: First Nations or Inuit? Eligible clients get dental care through the Non-Insured Health Benefits program. Show your client identification so the provider can bill the program directly.
dental.know.scam: It’s free to apply. Be wary of calls, texts or emails asking for your banking or card details.
dental.footnote: Your answers are saved on this device only, so you won’t have to answer again. We’ll never ask for your SIN.
